Not made or measured yet: check the first part
Scale 1.5:1 plans, 2:1 section, 8:1 detail, on A3. Dimensions in mm, computed from the model.
Datum A: back-left corner of the box round the outline, seen from above. X to the right, Y toward the front.
3-axis, two setups: underside up, then top side up.
Every vertical pocket corner is R1.5 or larger; the switch cut-outs have corner reliefs of that radius. The USB opening's rounds are not vertical: see its detail.
Switch cut-outs 14.00 +0.05/0 square, measured after anodise, in a 1.50 ±0.05 mm plate.
Key dish: flat floor on the plate, walls at 45 degrees, 3.5 deep. A 90 degree chamfer mill of 8 mm or more cuts the walls.
Screw holes S1-S6: M2x0.4-6H blind, from below, for M2 x 8; depth and thread of each in the table. S3 and S4 are flat bottomed: 0.8 mm of skin is left under the dish floor.
Setup 2 (top side up): hold the part on a fixture plate through the six M2 holes, or in soft jaws cut to the outline. The skirts are too thin for vise pressure.
Outline corners: one quintic Bezier each, control points 10.94, 6.56 and 2.19 mm from the box corner on both sides. Take the curve from the STEP file.
The STEP file is the master for all geometry not dimensioned on this sheet.
Bead blast all over, 120 to 150 grit glass bead, then anodise
to MIL-A-8625 Type II, Class 1 (clear, not dyed), 8 to 12 um.
Colour: natural silver, as in the renders. Cosmetic faces: the
About half the coating builds up: each face grows 0.004 to
0.006 mm. The tolerances below hold after anodise.
Break unmarked edges 0.05. The 0.3 chamfers are cosmetic:
Mask the six tapped M2 holes before anodising, or chase them
with an M2 6H tap after it. Rack marks: on the inner faces of
the skirt, in the cavity. Not on the top face, the outside,
the joint face or the lens recess.
GROUND: also mask the boss face round S1 on the joint face,
⌀5: it rests on a bare GND ring ⌀5.4 on the PCB.
S1-S6 positions from datum A: ±0.05, on both parts.
Flatness 0.05 on each lens ledge, 0.1 on the joint face (Z 0).
Cut it in setup 2, after the lens recess, with the same 3 mm
end mill, down to Z 6.35 (2.15 deep). The recess and the
opening then share their long walls without a step between
